title: Each type at a gully cricket match with cousins
caption:
Gully cricket with cousins: the purest form of the game, and the most arguments.

One studies every cousin's batting weakness. One invented three new rules mid-match. One keeps the official score in a notebook, and the notebook is the law. One bowls the fastest tape-ball the street has ever seen.

Tag your gully team captain.

Which one were you in your street?
